User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists in the processing of JPEG image dimensions. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to remote compromise under the credentials of the currently logged in user. Sun Microsystems has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
